<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:ext="urn:example:ext" id="Defs_1" targetNamespace="urn:example:target"><bpmn:process id="P1"><bpmn:extensionElements><ext:note id="Note_1" ext:level="high">hello</ext:note></bpmn:extensionElements></bpmn:process></bpmn:definitions>
upstreamReproduction.upstreamImport: parses with no warnings; generic element keeps own key ext:level ($type ext:note, descriptor ns {prefix ext, localName note, uri urn:example:ext})
upstreamReproduction.mechanism: moddle-xml ElementSerializer.nsAttributeName strips the prefix when the attribute namespace equals the element namespace ('strip prefix if same namespace like parent'); the reparse (key level) rewrites byte-identically, so the loss is stable.
